The SVG path defines two elliptical arc commands with the same start and end points, forming a closed shape. The parameters indicate two arcs with identical radii (26.04,26.04) and rotation (46.27°), creating an elliptical shape rather than a circle. Since it uses arcs with different x and y radii and forms a closed loop, it matches the definition of an ellipse.
